execution: sequential, new process group per child, kill owned group after exit or timeout; no automatic retries

parity.seed_lists: slot s in 0..3: [31+s+100*episode for episode in 0..256]; explicit lists saved in parity results
parity.actions: action[t,s] = ((t//16)+2*s)%9; complete predetermined vectors saved in parity results
parity.patterns_enabled: false for D1, true for D2
parity.powerups_enabled: false for D1, true for D2
parity.scope: synthetic explicit unit seeds, not B/E or any full study cohort; native evaluation-list mode only for old/new fixed-seed parity

integration.exclusions: validate exact collector HISTORICAL_RANGES floor before native construction
integration.policy: unchanged observation-only twelve-frame avoidance fixture from native binding controls, deterministic categorical logits; fixed CPU linear value head
integration.scheduler: begin one synthetic pending update, never finish or promote without PPO; zero optimizer steps
integration.split_buffer: two 128-decision pieces of one pending unit update; adapter decision offset only in unit instrumentation; no post-PPO claim
integration.failure_control: intentional guard exception after first actual native reset; no retry; retain unassigned_unaudited episode and returned startup work

stop: retain partial results, first failure and logs; no seed replacement, policy search, cap extension, production state forcing or checkpoint access
authority: finite descriptive CPU units only; no runtime qualification, global binary correspondence, study or launch authority
